fixed_management.notes: Fee as printed on Leumi's Directive 447A page ('0.19%'), which states 'המידע המוצג הוא בהתאם לדיווח שבוצע על ידי מנהלי הקרנות' and that for daily funds it shows the management fee the managers charge; the page's as-of date is filled by script ('{asOfDate}') and was not visible, so effective_from is unknown. Discount's 447A feed (lastUpdatedAt 2026-10-26T10:04) prints the same figure. Whether the figure includes the trustee fee is not stated (read as the manager's fee only). The manager's site (https://www.yl-invest.co.il/) returns an Imperva (Incapsula) block page to scripts (2026-10-26); not read. Exempt tax track: the fund's prospectus of 26.11.2024 (TXS-26) prints 'מסלול המס: פטורה'; Discount's feed field 'TaxStatusAsMeta' (not displayed on the page) also reads 'פטורה'. CONFLICT, kept as a note: the manager's prospectus of 26.11.2024 prints 'שכר מנהל הקרן: 0.12% מהשווי הנקי השנתי הממוצע של נכסי הקרן' with footnote 4: 'מנהל הקרן יהיה רשאי להעלות את השכר בקרן ביום 01.01.2026'. Both banks' current displays print 0.19%, so the current figure is the banks' and the prospectus figure is history.
